title: On the Negation of a Hyperbolic-Valued Probability Distribution
summary: In the context of hyperbolic numbers we define the concept of negation of finite hyperbolicvalued probability distributions that is based on the partial order induced by the idempotent structure of hyperbolic numbers. Then, a hyperbolic majorization and general hyperbolic negators are introduced. For a broad class of generated negators, we prove that the original distribution majorizes its negation.
